name: Szántód (Hungary)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly into a medium blue upper hoist part and a green lower fly part, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Szántód (a quartered shield with a tree, a ferry, fish, an anchor and bars) above a scroll inscribed SZÁNTÓD.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
